title: Satellite Imagery Shows Xi Jinping Pre-Visit Preparations at Pyongyang — Reviewing Stand Erected at Kim Il Sung Square
detail: Satellite imagery and open-source analysis published on June 1, 2026 showed construction of a reviewing stand structure at Kim Il Sung Square in central Pyongyang — a pattern consistent with preparations for a major foreign state visit. South Korean media reported that eight Air Koryo aircraft had been repositioned at Sunan International Airport, another indicator of anticipated high-level foreign movement. The preparation pattern closely mirrors those observed before Russian President Vladimir Putin's state visit to Pyongyang in June 2024. South Korean analysts and the Seoul Economic Daily reported speculation that Xi Jinping may be planning an imminent state visit to Pyongyang, which would be his first since June 2019. China-DPRK diplomatic ties have deepened since China's March 2024 veto eliminating the UN Panel of Experts monitoring mechanism, and the bilateral relationship has grown amid shared strategic interest in constraining US-allied power in the region. A Xi visit would signal further consolidation of the Beijing-Pyongyang-Moscow trilateral alignment. No official confirmation from Beijing, Pyongyang, or KCNA was available as of June 1, 2026. DPRK state media routinely does not pre-announce foreign visits.
